description: Set the length of zones on the edge. If the specified zone length causes the number of zones on the edge to exceed the limits (1-10000), the limit value is used for the edge.

keywords.name: min-size
keywords.description: Set the minimum number of zones on an edge even if the provided length value would otherwise produce a smaller number of zones. The keyword is useful to assure that there would be at least certain number of zones (or more) on edges when setting length for multiple edges at once.
